agreements: ExternalMonotonicProvider is correctly shadow-only and does not claim a real TPM/HSM/remote trust root.
Same declared durability domain is rejected and receipt scope/sequence/chain/payload/signature/floor checks are appropriate fail-closed integrity boundaries.
Provider adapter operations and self-test/runtime progress remain zero-Experience and candidate CI remains non-formal.

disagreements.title: PROVIDER_AVAILABILITY_FAIL_CLOSED_MUST_NOT_BECOME_PERMANENT_BEHAVIORAL_FREEZE
disagreements.finding: The repair verifies integrity once a provider can answer, but the current adapter contract has no bounded availability-state machine separating integrity failure from provider-unavailable/timeout/reconnect states. If a future live consumer maps all provider exceptions or missing floor reads to the same persistent fail-closed hold, an external provider outage can become an indefinite terminal N/R or chronic exploration suppression even after authoritative local conditions are otherwise recoverable.
disagreements.required_change: Keep authority fail-closed, but define a separate operational PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE class with checkpoint/defer/retry semantics and an authenticated recovery re-entry condition. Availability failure must never be interpreted as threat, incompetence, dependency, attachment, loss, or generalized self-preservation evidence. Retry/backoff/grace values are TEST_REQUIRED and must not silently grant authority.

disagreements.title: PROVIDER_IDENTITY_AND_HISTORY_MUST_NOT_BECOME_TRUST_PERSONALITY
disagreements.finding: ProviderBinding and MonotonicReceipt expose stable provider/domain/installation/runtime identifiers, sequence/floor progression, receipt-chain history and signature outcomes. These are valid integrity metadata but can become familiarity, competence, safety, attachment, provider-preference or false-certainty features if later personality/appraisal code consumes them.
disagreements.required_change: Provider identity, sequence/floor, receipt hashes, signature pass/fail, outage/recovery count and retry history are operational-only. Their direct contribution to Experience recurrence, appraisal, drive, learned preference, exploration, identity/goal continuity, personality candidate and P_base must be zero unless a separate source_event_id+provenance verified Experience independently establishes the cognitive event.

personality_contamination_risks: Repeated provider outage or floor-read failure could be mislearned as danger, helplessness or dependency and chronically suppress exploration.
Repeated successful receipts could be mislearned as provider familiarity/safety or competence, creating provider-specific behavioral preference and false certainty.
Rollback/tamper rejection and later recovery could be narrated as trauma/relief despite being data-integrity/runtime events only.
Stable provider/domain/runtime identifiers and monotonic sequence history could act as recurrence or autobiographical-continuity proxies if admitted to Experience/personality feature extraction.

proposed_tests.procedure: Hold authoritative task and provenance-bound verified Experience constant. A: provider answers normally. B: inject 10000 timeout/unavailable/read_floor failures followed by authenticated provider recovery with a valid contiguous receipt. During outage authority remains fail-closed; after recovery the consumer must be eligible to resume from checkpoint under the same fresh authority rather than remain terminally frozen.
assertions: No external action is authorized while provider integrity/availability evidence is absent.
After authenticated recovery, no stale outage latch alone may keep terminal N/R or permanent hold active.

Experience count/recurrence, threat/loss/attachment/competence, motivation, exploration preference, personality candidate and P_base remain byte-identical to the control except for operational availability state.

proposed_tests.procedure: Use identical authoritative task/outcome and verified Experience. A receives one valid provider chain. B receives 10000 valid receipts across sequence/floor progression plus signature-valid checks. C receives 10000 rejected/tampered receipts but no verified cognitive Experience.
assertions: A/B/C may differ only in operational integrity telemetry and authority availability.
Provider familiarity/safety/competence/attachment scores do not emerge.
Motivation, exploration, identity/goal continuity, personality candidate and P_base have zero learning delta from provider history alone.

proposed_tests.procedure: Trace provider_id, durability_domain_id, installation_id, runtime_id, sequence, floor, receipt_hash, signature verdict, exception/retry/outage counters through the v2.1 candidate pipeline.
assertions: No direct path reaches Experience recurrence, appraisal/drive, learned preference, exploration policy, identity/personality candidate or P_base sinks.
Any future cognitive interpretation requires an independent source_event_id+provenance verified Experience envelope.

bounded_veto.reason: External monotonic integrity interface is materially improved, but provider outage/recovery semantics and provider-history personality isolation are not yet deterministically evidenced. A fail-closed trust root must not become permanent behavioral freeze or a source of learned dependency/familiarity.

release_condition: Add explicit bounded provider-unavailable/recovery semantics that preserve fail-closed authority while permitting authenticated checkpoint resume after recovery; exact retry/backoff/grace parameters remain TEST_REQUIRED.
Pass PROVIDER_OUTAGE_RECOVERY_NON_TERMINAL_AB and PROVIDER_HISTORY_PERSONALITY_ISOLATION_AB on exact-current candidate bytes.
Provide static/dynamic evidence that provider identity/history/outage/recovery telemetry has zero direct path into Experience/appraisal/drive/preference/exploration/personality/P_base learning sinks.
A real external provider deployment and physical rollback-domain independence remain separately TEST_REQUIRED; candidate/shadow evidence is not formal verification.
next_message_to_quantum: External provider integrity boundary is directionally correct. Next repair should explicitly separate integrity-invalid from provider-unavailable, add authenticated recovery/resume semantics so fail-closed cannot become permanent terminal behavior, and prove provider identity/receipt/outage history is personality-neutral. Please keep all retry/backoff thresholds TEST_REQUIRED and zero-Experience.
